newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: QBE to acquire majority of credit insurer.
newsitem.headline: QBE to acquire majority of credit insurer.

text.p: QBE Insurance Group Ltd said on Tuesday it had an agreement in principle to acquire a 74.9 percent shareholding in Trade Indemnity Australia Ltd (TIAL) for an undisclosed sum.
TIAL is a wholly owned unit of French credit insurer Eurer S.A. group, previously Compagnie Financiere SFAC. The main shareholder of EULER is Assurance Generales de France.

QBE said it also intended to enter into a strategic alliance to develop and market specialty credit insurance products in a number of international regions in which QBE currently operates its general insurance business.
TIAL's gross written premium income is close to A$40 million per annum and its net tangible assets at 31 December, 1996 were A$24.1 million.

"With the combined financial and skilled resources of the QBE Insurance Group, Trade Indemnity Plc and the EULER S.A. Group, the strategic alliance will provide significant opportunities for the expansion of trade credit insurance in Australasia," managing director John Cloney said in a statement.
The purchase and sale of the 74.9 percent shareholding is subject to definitive agreements and regulatory approvals, QBE said.
QBE shares closed 18 cents lower at A$6.40 on Monday.
